Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Mid-Century Modern Wood Nightstand, 24", Brown, Metal Base
Colors: Brown
Materials: wood
Warm wood with vertical lines and a criss-cross metal base give this mid-century nightstand a clean, sleek look. Two spacious drawers store accessories and essentials such as reading glasses and remote controls. 24"W x 17"D x 24"H; Leg Height: 6.75" Two storage drawers No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
